Phase.description: Business interaction progress, separate from Identity session state.

oneOf.description: Intent committed; Identity challenge not yet durably attached.
A single completion attempt owns the interaction.
External exchange outcome is unknown; start a new interaction after reconciliation.
A bounded one-use backend handoff is available.
The exact RP backend consumed the handoff.
User cancelled the interaction; no new RP session may consume it.
A known failure did not establish an RP session.

Secret.description: Canonical 256-bit base64url secret. Debug output is always redacted.

description: Public status never exposes assertions, Identity credentials or IdP access tokens.

callback.description: Fixed callback, present only for an available handoff.

continuation.description: One-use locator for the authenticated RP backend, never an Identity bearer token.

expiresAt.description: Original deadline, never extended by polling.

title: Status
